content.title: Applebee’s® Delivers New 2 for $20 Menu - Limited Time Special
content.text: 2 FOR $20 — OUR BEST DEAL JUST GOT BETTER! Now featuring the Southwest Steak Bowl! Looking for the perfect date night? Applebee’s has you covered with 2 for $20! Choose two entrées and one full-size appetizer, all for just $20. Featuring the Classic Bacon Cheeseburger, Fiesta Lime Chicken, and now, for a limited time only, the Southwest Steak Bowl. Available dine in, delivery, and to-go! Southwest Steak Bowl Tender steak served over a bed of salad and rice and topped with pico, guac, salsa, chimichurri sauce and tortilla strips. Classic Bacon Cheeseburger An all-beef patty topped with two slices of American cheese and two strips of Applewood-smoked bacon, served on a brioche bun. Fiesta Lime Chicken Grilled chicken glazed with zesty lime sauce and smothered with cheddar cheese on a bed of crispy tortilla strips. Full-Size Appetizer: Boneless Wings Crispy breaded pieces of tender boneless chicken tossed in your choice of Classic Hot Buffalo sauce, Honey BBQ sauce, or Sweet Asian chile sauce. Served with Bleu cheese or ranch dressing. Limited time. Price, participation and selection may vary. In-restaurant dining is not available in all markets. ©2020 Applebee’s Restaurants LLC.
